scope.document_snapshot: EN phase1 (2026-10-20/21); not re-read from production
scope.note: aggregates only; SO/WO/PO identifiers are document-level keys, not order lines

time_alignment.treatment: SO/WO balances are 2026-10-20/21 and inventory is 2026-10-22. The intervening movements cannot be reconciled without production access, so balances are treated as unchanged through the decision time; this is an unquantified time-point scenario, not a bridge.

cover_evidence.note: B v2.1 cover/ETA/UOM evidence; cover is scenario only, not added to supply

gs_orders.note: all rows aggregated; no row dropped; months between first order and 2026-09 filled with 0 only when gs_orders has no row

po.note: open = open_qty > 0; closed rows kept in count but not in supply

method.demand: monthly sum(qty) by despatch_date month; cutoff 2026-09-30; gs_orders has no order-status column, so cancellation/return exclusion is not possible at this layer and is unproven
method.forecast_primary: seasonal_naive (lag 12) when history >= 24 months; otherwise mean of last 3 months; low confidence <24 months
method.forecast_candidate: Holt-Winters additive (level+trend+seasonal, grid-search alpha/beta/gamma); reported, not selected
method.p90: month h: p50_h + z_sig*sqrt(h); cumulative 3m: sum(p50) + z_sig*sqrt(1+2+3)=sqrt(6); consistent random-walk error model; z_sig=1.2816*sigma_used; sigma_used=max(in-sample effective sigma, rolling-origin h1 std) calibrated over all eligible origins, not only the 6 reporting origins; rolling bias is reported but not corrected
method.backtest: last 6 origins with known h=3; zero-actual cells retained (all-zero denominator -> WAPE/bias null); P90 coverage = share actual<=P90; target 0.90 recorded separately from achieved coverage; achieved coverage below 0.90 -> P90 labelled estimate
method.supply_A: bounds: A_low=available (no production); A_high=available+open production remaining (no PO); no intransit
method.supply_B: bounds: B_min=available+max(raw PO, production remaining, intransit) (maximum overlap: union is at least the largest component); B_max=available+raw PO+all production+intransit (no overlap, all components added). PO duplicate-candidate sensitivity: B_min_po_dedup / B_max_po_dedup. B_mid treats intransit as already inside the open PO (observed intransit==deduped PO) and production as partially overlapping; it is an assumption, not a verified link. PO arrival within lead time is an assumption (ETA all null)
method.open_so: positive remaining per live SO line; over-delivery on other lines is NOT netted against it (kept separate)
method.production: open WO = docstatus=1 and status in (Not Started, In Process); remaining = max(0, qty - produced_qty); Draft/Stopped excluded and shown separately
method.production_uom_assumption: WO production_item is PK#皮壳; counted 1:1 against the KS finished item (not proven)
method.po_dedup: identical (sku, warehouse, quantity) open lines across different POs: later purchase_date treated as duplicate candidate; not document-proven
method.recommendation: max(0, P90(lead+30d calendar window) - supply bound); unrounded; no MOQ/pack multiple; not order-ready
method.lead_time: calendar window from 2026-10-22; partial-month weights (Oct 22-31 = 10/31); monthly h has variance h*sigma^2; Jan+ uses the 3-month average rate (extrapolation, not an independent forecast); document balances are 10-20/21 and are not rolled forward to 10-22
method.censoring: NOT corrected: only 3 days of stock history, cannot reconstruct lost sales

queries.demand: SELECT sku_tongtool, substr(despatch_date,1,7) AS ym, SUM(qty) FROM gs_orders WHERE sku_tongtool IN (<10 customer codes>) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
queries.stock: SELECT goods_sku, warehouse_name, available, intransit, waiting_shipment, defects, batch_complete, is_test, uom_basis FROM stock_history WHERE goods_sku IN (<10 customer codes>) AND snapshot_date='2026-10-22'
queries.stock_latest: SELECT warehouse, sku, available, intransit, waiting_shipment, defects FROM stock_latest WHERE sku IN (<10 customer codes>)
queries.po: SELECT ponum, goods_sku, warehouse, quantity, in_quantity, open_qty, status, purchase_date, will_arrive_date FROM tongtool_po WHERE goods_sku IN (<10 customer codes>)
queries.po_open: SELECT sku, warehouse, on_order FROM tongtool_po_open WHERE sku IN (<10 customer codes>)
queries.replenishment_v3: SELECT * FROM replenishment_v3 WHERE sku IN (<10 customer codes>) -- cross-check only; 10-21 pool, excludes Wayfair 3PL
queries.cover: cover evidence copied from out/eta_cover_uom/evidence.json (sha256 in sources)
queries.en_snapshot: json['wos'], json['so_rows'], json['open_breakdown'] from each g1b_en_*.json

exclusions.reason: all 10 have confirmed 1:1 customer-code -> KS item mapping in sku_map; no identity-unknown SKU inside the fixed phase1 scope
exclusions.outside_scope: rest of gs_orders catalog not expanded (user sovereignty; narrow pilot only)

open_items: 6 SKUs / 13 open PO lines / 1465 units have no will_arrive_date; Scenario B is an assumption, not an ETA
Open WOs have planned_end_date = null for all open WOs; production arrival date unconfirmed
Open WOs produce PK# covers; counted 1:1 against KS finished items. Insert (ND#) availability and assembly are not modeled
PO<->production and PO<->intransit overlap is not linked; B_min (maximum overlap) and B_max (no overlap) are bounds, not a point; no max(WO-PO,0) or max(transit-PO,0) is treated as verified supply

intransit equals the deduped open PO at 10/10 SKUs, which indicates (but does not prove) that intransit is the same goods as the open PO; B_max therefore double-counts them by design and is an extreme upper bound
stock UOM is unknown (stock_history.uom_basis=unknown for all rows); quantities treated as pieces, no conversion
Cover substitution is not proven; cover stock is not added to supply
stockout censoring not corrected (3 days of stock history)
gs_orders has no order-status field; cancellation/return exclusion is not possible and unproven
PO duplicate candidates (PO021733 vs PO021735 on 3 SKUs) are a separate sensitivity; the document relation is unproven
document balances (SO/WO) are 2026-10-20/21; inventory is 10-22; intervening movements are not bridged
rolling-origin calibration is out-of-sample per fit but overlaps the 6 reporting origins; achieved coverage is reported, not claimed as a 90% service guarantee
